title: Live-target authorisation record (KREQ-558)
description: Read from .kit/live-target-authorisation.json on the default branch before any DAST run or deployed scan (scripts/live_target_authorisation.py). An entry is in force for (scan, environment, target) when all three are named exactly, authorised_on <= today <= expires_on, and the window is at most 366 days. Absent, malformed, expired or out of scope is PREREQUISITE_UNAVAILABLE: the scan is not run.

authorised_by.description: A role, never a person's name.

reference.description: The change or ticket that records the target owner's agreement.
